notes.title: Inn Tycoon is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]After nearly 50 test builds, more than 5 Steam reviews, and months of work, we're proud and excited to announce that we've officially been Steam Deck Verified! We learned a lot throughout this process and had to make some adjustments to the UI as a result.[/p][list][*][p]Font sizes have been increased to a minimum of 9px.[/p][/*][*][p]Window sizes have been enlarged.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrollbars were added to longer text messages.[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope you have a great time playing on the Steam Deck!

 ❤️ from Evil Goose Games[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes For Mar 18
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After the last content update, we are releasing a new update that includes a few long-awaited features and bug fixes. Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to delete saved games.
[*] NPC names now adapt based on the selected language.
[*] Pet animations have been improved (especially for large dogs).
[*] Nightstand mirroring issue has been fixed.
[*] Floating food bug has been fixed.
[*] 6 new customer types have been added (based on the Fortune Teller model).
[*] Missing flower decoration object names have been added.
[*] A "Random Inn Name" button has been added.
[*] Customers' happiness levels are now displayed in their profile.
[*] The difficulty of many quests has been reduced.
[i](When you load older saves, you might see the objective progress is higher than expected, the quest will be completed after a single progression. For example: 10/8 Tavern object, just place one more object and the quest will be completed.)[/i]
[*] The first story event will now appear on day 9 instead of day 10.
[/list]

❤️ from Evil Goose Games

notes.title: Pet Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/cb25c04ec3c91f4b8b37244016454d5ba006829c.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

After the QOL updates, we are launching our first update from the Roadmap. With this update, the most requested feature of automatically collecting tips will be implemented. You'll be able to adopt pets, and they will collect tips on your behalf. We've added 15 different pet types for now, but we plan to add more in the future along with different animal species. You will be able to choose your pet from 5 random animals in the middle of Day 10. In our next update, we plan to allow you to adopt more pets. Here are the pets we've added:

[list]
[*] Orange Cat
[*] Black Cat
[*] Harlequin Cat
[*] Tuxedo Cat
[*] White Cat
[*] Toyger Cat
[*] Golden Retriever
[*] Beagle
[*] Border Collie
[*] Boxer
[*] Corgi
[*] Husky
[*] Jack Russell Terrier
[*] Shepherd
[*] Shiba Inu
[/list]
We are happy to announce that community items are now available! We've added 8 trading cards, 4 profile backgrounds, and 5 different emotes for you to earn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/c32fe4b8c54955dff32f9daeffeaaaeb76e87b73.png[/img]
Additionally, we’ve added bug fixes, improvements, and new content. Most of these are based on your feedback and suggestions, so please keep them coming!

[list]
[*] 6 cat and 9 dog breeds have been added.
[*] A new UI has been designed to make the inputs more understandable.
[*] New flower decorations have been added.
[*] Level skins for Game Room objects have been added.
[*] Staff icons have been varied based on their appearance.
[*] Fixed a bug where customers were not paying the correct price.
[/list]

❤️ from Evil Goose Games

notes.title: Update Notes For Sep 11
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Since the game's release, we heard many feedbacks about cellar objects. We made improvements to address the imbalance. We have adjusted the bonuses of the cellar objects and added expiration times. This way, cellar bonuses have become more balanced. Additionally, we have added new events that can shorten or lengthen expiration times. For example, expiration times for cellar objects are extended during the winter season, while they are shortened during the summer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/c485a16ee293b7365f278acf220bb9fe0b2a758d.png[/img]
We have also added a few events related to the frequently mentioned issue of unhappy customers leaving. You can now increase customer patience. :) The full change log is as follows:

[list]
[*] Expiration Time added to Cellar Objects. 
[*] Cellar Objects are no longer refundable when demolished.
[*] Mead Dispenser price and pouring time adjusted. 
[*] 3 new weather conditions. 
[*] 6 new events.
[*] Customer Patience feature added. 
[*] Some pathfinding and seasonal bugs fixed. 
[*] Increased chance of dirt appearance.
[*] Hidden Achievement is removed. 750 Tip achievement is added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/7de2445eaee276644ceba2fcefb7451c19835a48.png[/img]

We also want to show you a screenshot of the pets we promised. Our post-launch updates will continue, but we will primarily focus on releasing the pet update as planned. Don’t forget to let us know which pets you want to see!

❤️ from Evil Goose Games

notes.title: Dev Log #1 - New Light System
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The game’s release is just 3 days away, and we’re very excited. This post is our first dev log where we’ll be keeping you updated on the frequent improvements we’re making and plan to make throughout Early Access. Please share your thoughts with us, and let’s make Inn Tycoon an even better game together. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/3ea0dc78f96f61c118775643e0d085bce90b6bf8.png[/img]

We’ve been working on the lighting system for a long time due to Unity’s limitations. We always aim to provide graphics that are not only fun but also beautiful and atmospheric. We believe this is crucial for the experience we want to deliver.

[h3]What’s changed:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/90f5a2d8e1624e8d03bb5b33eb070d46171cfa9a.png[/img]

The inn is generally brighter, and reflections look much more natural. NPC faces are more defined, and objects now cast shadows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819223/a417b2f02f350234a21263c5e2a2c103a9c7e926.png[/img]

NPCs cast shadows like objects, and the reflections from torches are much more realistic. The walls also better capture the dark, cozy atmosphere.

We’ve been working on this feature for a long time (2 months). Alongside all of this, we’ve also seen improvements in performance. We hope you like it!

❤️ from Evil Goose Games

notes.title: Inn Tycoon is coming to Early Access on Aug 26th* !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're thrilled to announce that Inn Tycoon, our cozy inn management game, is coming to Steam Early Access on [strike]Aug 28[/strike] [b]Aug 26, 2024[/b]!

We believe our game, which we've been working on for a long time, is ready to be shown to everyone. By launching in Early Access, we will make our game even better together. There are just two of us, but we believe with you, we will become thousands. :)

[h3]What do we plan to add in Early Access?[/h3]

[*] New staff members

We can't wait to grow and develop the game together with your feedback!
